archetypes.name: summary-visibility
archetypes.rationale: Final reports must be visible outside collapsible tool output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the SKILL.md delivery-channel wording for every final-summary emit path. Verify it forbids Bash or Python extraction output and preserves Read-tool fallback semantics without paraphrasing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: structure-pins
archetypes.rationale: Regression harnesses now enforce prompt-shape invariants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the new structure-test assertions for false positives and false negatives. Pay special attention to bash-fence detection, exact pinned literals, and whether legitimate prose references to final-summary markers remain allowed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
